description: crate-jmap-cid-types/Cargo.toml:14 declares jmap-types = { workspace = true } but grep finds zero uses of jmap_types in src/ or tests. PLAN.md lines 56-63 acknowledges this and says it is reserved for a future D.2 step that may need it. Two problems with leaving the reservation in place: (1) cargo udeps / -W unused-crate-dependencies / cargo-deny will flag this once enabled on the workspace; the noise compounds across the 30+ jmap-* crates if each one carries a speculative dep. (2) jmap-cid-types is the first published crate in this workspace to ship with a dead dep; future contributors will copy the pattern. Two viable fixes: (a) drop the dep from Cargo.toml now and re-add it in the same commit that introduces the consumer code, or (b) use jmap_types::Id in a Sha256 method (e.g. typed accessor returning Id-shaped blob references) if that fits a real use case. Option (a) is cleaner — JMAP-v9py.12 added the Sha256 type without needing jmap-types, so the reservation has not earned its keep.
title: Cargo.toml: jmap-types dep is declared but never used in source
